tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Paper: the page behind cards and lists. A warm off-white, a warm near-black at night.

tokens.name: linen-raised
tokens.usage: Cells, cards, answer choices, sheets: a lighter sheet of paper on the page.

tokens.name: linen-sunk
tokens.usage: Tertiary fill: progress tracks, disabled buttons, input wells, segmented control track.

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary fill: pressed cells, the selected segment's ground in dark mode, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: segment-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected thumb of a segmented control.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Translucent bar material for the tab bar and compact navigation header (use with backdrop blur).

tokens.name: material-thick
tokens.usage: Tab bar, navigation bar when scrolled, sheets and docks: blur(24px) saturate(180%) behind it.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline list separators (1px, inset).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet card and cell borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Resting border of answer choices, tiles and inputs; off level dots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Label: primary text. A warm near-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary label: subtitles, transliteration, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on linen, linen-raised and linen-sunk.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled glyphs only. Not for readable text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Filled primary button and selected-segment fill, with on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The Г brand tile and app icon. The same deep rose in both themes; never a text colour.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Brand accent as text and icons: links, the active tab, selection borders, the streak. On linen and linen-raised.

tokens.name: rose-deep
tokens.usage: Darker rose for pressed tinted controls and ring ends.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Faint rose tint behind tinted buttons and selected choices.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose text on rose-soft.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Text on a solid rose fill (badges). Dark in dark mode, where rose is light.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: Selected answer before checking: border and text. Alias of rose.

tokens.name: pick-soft
tokens.usage: Selected answer background. Alias of rose-soft.

tokens.name: pick-deep
tokens.usage: Selected answer pressed. Alias of rose-deep.

tokens.name: select-fill
tokens.usage: Background of a selected answer cell; pair with a 1.5px pick border. Neutral in dark so selections never look maroon.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Correct: icons, borders and text on linen-raised; the Continue button after a right answer.

tokens.name: pine-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed correct button.

tokens.name: pine-soft
tokens.usage: Correct answer panel and correct choice background.

tokens.name: pine-ink
tokens.usage: Green text on pine-soft.

tokens.name: on-pine
tokens.usage: Label on a pine fill.

tokens.name: pine-fill
tokens.usage: Filled Continue button on the correct-answer sheet, with on-fill labels. Deeper than pine in dark so it never looks neon.

tokens.name: pine-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of pine-fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Not quite: icons, borders and text on linen-raised; the Got it button after a wrong answer. Amber, so it never competes with the rose accent.

tokens.name: warn-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed not-quite button.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Not-quite panel and wrong choice background.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Amber text on warn-soft.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Label on a warn fill.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Filled Continue button on the not-quite sheet, with on-fill labels.

tokens.name: warn-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of warn-fill.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: White labels on pine-fill and warn-fill in both themes.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rewards as icons only: XP glyph, completed level dots in stats. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Darker reward tone for ring ends.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Reward tint: streak calendar cells.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-family text (XP numbers) on linen-raised and gold-soft.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Label on a gold fill.

tokens.name: trk-azbuka
tokens.usage: Alphabet: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-azbuka-deep
tokens.usage: Alphabet: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-azbuka-soft
tokens.usage: Alphabet: small tinted badge background behind trk-azbuka icons.

tokens.name: trk-basics
tokens.usage: Basics: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-basics-deep
tokens.usage: Basics: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-basics-soft
tokens.usage: Basics: small tinted badge background behind trk-basics icons.

tokens.name: trk-kids
tokens.usage: Kids: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-kids-deep
tokens.usage: Kids: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-kids-soft
tokens.usage: Kids: small tinted badge background behind trk-kids icons.

tokens.name: trk-love
tokens.usage: Love: the brand rose.

tokens.name: trk-love-deep
tokens.usage: Love: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-love-soft
tokens.usage: Love: tinted badge background.

tokens.name: trk-home
tokens.usage: Home: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-home-deep
tokens.usage: Home: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-home-soft
tokens.usage: Home: small tinted badge background behind trk-home icons.

tokens.name: trk-family
tokens.usage: Family: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-family-deep
tokens.usage: Family: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-family-soft
tokens.usage: Family: small tinted badge background behind trk-family icons.

tokens.name: trk-grammar
tokens.usage: Grammar: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-grammar-deep
tokens.usage: Grammar: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-grammar-soft
tokens.usage: Grammar: small tinted badge background behind trk-grammar icons.

tokens.name: trk-out
tokens.usage: Out and about: track badge, icon and progress ring. Never a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: trk-out-deep
tokens.usage: Out and about: pressed or completed ring.

tokens.name: trk-out-soft
tokens.usage: Out and about: small tinted badge background behind trk-out icons.

tokens.name: on-track
tokens.usage: Glyph or label on a solid trk-* fill.

fonts.name: Literata
fonts.usage: Titles, numbers and every Bulgarian word.

families.display: "Literata Variable", "Literata", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
families.text: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter Variable", "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Literata, a book serif with a true Cyrillic. Titles carry hierarchy; keep one large title per screen.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The title of each tab screen, once.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The system font (SF Pro on iPhone; Inter elsewhere) for everything you read in English. Sentence case everywhere, buttons included.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small heading above a card title, in ink-muted and sentence case (use the t-eyebrow class, which sets the colour). Never rose.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Section headers (uppercase is not used), transliteration, metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small labels: stat labels, metadata. Never smaller than 13pt.

groups.name: Learning
groups.note: The Bulgarian being taught, always in Literata so the language has its own voice. Tag it lang="bg".

styles.name: bg-hero
styles.usage: The Bulgarian word on the new-word intro: the hero moment of a lesson.

styles.name: bg-word
styles.usage: The word or phrase being taught.

styles.name: letter
styles.usage: A single Cyrillic letter on letter cards.

groups.name: Bulgarian style
groups.note: Sofia Sans draws the Bulgarian Cyrillic forms (д like g, т like m). Only for the alternate glyph on letter cards.

styles.name: bg-alt
styles.usage: The 'you may also see it like this' glyph.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: chips, tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between answer choices; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above large titles and hero content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Generous breathing room on empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tiles, keys, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer choices, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, rings, progress bars.

ledge.note: Retired. The old chunky ledges are gone; kept at 0 so older styles still resolve.

tokens.name: ledge-sm
tokens.usage: Retired, always 0.

tokens.name: ledge-md
tokens.usage: Retired, always 0.

tokens.name: ledge-lg
tokens.usage: Retired, always 0.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and cells: a hairline edge and a soft, warm lift, like paper on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, popovers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a ground-colour gap, then solid rose.
